A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT WONDER

Let’s make
it easy.

How do I book an appointment?+

Call +91 70152 40995 to ask the clinic for an available appointment. Your appointment is confirmed directly by the clinic.

Where is the clinic?+

Radiant Smiles is listed at Booth Number 1, Indira Colony, Jagadhri, Haryana 135003. Use the directions link above and call before your visit.

What should I bring to my first visit?+

Ask the clinic when booking whether you should bring any previous dental reports, X-rays or a list of your current medicines.

Can I see more of the clinic?+

Visit @_.radiantsmiles on Instagram and explore the Our Space and Dr. N highlights.
